punchline: The book says a feeling allowed to pass lasts about 90 seconds, while one you suppress can turn into a mood.
thirty_sec: One commitment in the book is to feel your feelings all the way through. First you find the sensation in your body, then you take a few gentle breaths, then you give it a sound or a movement. The authors say venting to a coworker can keep you in a loop and that suppression causes problems. The 90-second figure is their own claim.
